theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (f : Euclid n → Euclid k), (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → ∀ (G : Euclid n → ℝ≥0∞) (t : ℝ), (∫⁻ v in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) t, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 ^ n * ∑ i : Fin n, ‖fderiv ℝ f v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * G v) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + n * 2 ^ n) * (∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) t, G v)
